import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def make_grid(h,w,centers):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in centers:
        for rr,cc in ((r-1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1),(r+1,c)): g[rr][cc]=2
    return g
def added(g,out): return {(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(out) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1}
examples=[
 (make_grid(10,15,[(1,3),(1,10),(5,10)]), {(1,c) for c in range(5,9)}|{(3,10)}),
 (make_grid(14,16,[(3,3),(3,8),(3,13),(10,2),(9,8)]), {(3,c) for c in (5,6,10,11)}|{(r,8) for r in (5,6,7)}),
 (make_grid(12,15,[(1,8),(4,4),(4,11),(9,4),(9,11)]), {(4,c) for c in range(6,10)}|{(9,c) for c in range(6,10)}|{(r,c) for r in (6,7) for c in (4,11)})
]
checks=[added(g,mod.transform(g))==expected for g,expected in examples]
print(checks, [added(g,mod.transform(g)) for g,_ in examples])
